description: The plot illustrates the relative change in an unspecified metric across different layers, comparing various configurations. The x-axis is labeled with layer ranges (Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, Layer29-32) and has a categorical scale. The y-axis is labeled "Relative Change," has a linear scale, ranges from -25% to 5%, and has tick labels at intervals of 5%. The plot includes five lines representing different configurations: "LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit" (yellow, circle markers, solid line), "LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit" (red, circle markers, solid line), "RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit" (light blue, square markers, solid line), "RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit" (dark blue, square markers, solid line), and "Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit" (gray, dashed line). The yellow line starts at 0% and remains relatively stable, ending at 0%. The red line begins at approximately -1%, decreases to around -3% at Layer13-20, and then slightly increases to about -2% at Layer29-32. The light blue line starts at around -2%, decreases to approximately -12% at Layer13-20, and then increases to about -4% at Layer29-32. The dark blue line begins at around -3%, decreases to approximately -24% at Layer13-20, and then increases to about -7% at Layer29-32. The gray dashed line remains constant at 0%.
